entries.en: to publish, make publicly known; to proclaim
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语、汉字、官话三栏皆空，音写栏仅存两音节且声调污损（T99）；据前后 publicar 词族推测或为『顯揚』一类义，不可证实

entries.zh: 扬人之过、播人恶名；诽谤、毁谤
entries.en: to publish another's faults; to slander, defame

entries.en: to publish one's name; to make renowned, spread one's fame

entries.zh: 称扬他人美德；赞扬、褒奖
entries.en: to publish someone's virtues; to praise, extol, commend
to display openly, make illustrious; to flaunt
to proclaim to the multitude, spread publicly

entries.zh: 遍传于众、使众人皆知（消息）
entries.en: to spread (a report) among all, publish everywhere
entries.notes: 汉字栏『遍/週』存疑、音写栏首音节存疑且两处声调污损（T99），仅据西语 publicar … entre todos 与『遍』义互证

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.en: lit. child's stew-pots; does not accord with the character 氣, gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 西语 Pucheros del niño 与汉字『氣』互证不成，疑原件有讹字（或为『器』类器皿字），无从证实
